meta.dq_scale: PCAF data quality, 1 is measured and 5 is a sector average
meta.note: Counts are non-null rows in data/master/master_company.parquet.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR XBRL
sources.gives: Revenue, EBIT, capex, debt and cover-page shares
sources.licence_full: US federal government work, public domain (SEC EDGAR); the constituent list is ODC-PDDL-1.0
sources.dq_note: Audited filings, read from company facts rather than a vendor copy.

sources.name: SEC DERA statement sets
sources.gives: Segment revenue for the Article 12 revenue screens
sources.dq_note: Same filings, segment level. Every company is tested, 67 are barred.

sources.name: S&P 500 constituents
sources.gives: Index membership, CIK, GICS sector, listing dates
sources.licence_full: ODC-PDDL-1.0 (public domain dedication), declared in the package's datapackage.json
sources.dq_note: Rebuilt daily. 503 listings, 500 of them primary.

sources.name: EUR-Lex 2020/1818
sources.gives: The Paris-aligned benchmark rules, parsed from the text
sources.dq_note: 24 rules and 6 definitions parsed straight from the regulation text.

sources.name: EPA eGRID
sources.gives: Grid emission factor for each subregion
sources.licence_full: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).
sources.dq_note: Applied at headquarters, which is a proxy for where the power is drawn.

sources.name: Violation Tracker
sources.licence_full: No open licence is offered. Page footers carry '© 2026 Good Jobs First'.
sources.dq_note: Enforcement records are public. Detection is biased to regulated industry.

sources.name: EPA GHGRP
sources.gives: Measured Scope 1 at every US facility above 25,000 t
sources.licence_full: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); EPA requests attribution.
sources.dq_note: Filed under penalty of law. Stops at reporting year 2023.

sources.name: EPA CAMD Part 75
sources.gives: Stack-measured CO2 from power and large combustion units
sources.licence_full: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).
sources.dq_note: Hourly monitors, audited. Runs to 2026, so it dates the GHGRP lag.

sources.name: EIA Form 923
sources.gives: Plant net generation, the denominator of power intensity
sources.licence_full: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105). Form EIA-923.
sources.dq_note: Only the S&P 500 names that own generation appear here.

sources.name: Science Based Targets initiative
sources.licence_full: Website terms of use permit retrieving and storing content for research and other non-commercial use, provided the Science Based Targets initiative is credited as the source with a link to the relevant page.
sources.dq_note: A validated target is still only a promise about 2030.

sources.name: World Benchmarking Alliance
sources.gives: Company-disclosed Scope 1, 2 and 3 and target text
sources.licence_full: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0), the terms WBA states on its fair-use-donation page for its methodologies, benchmarks, scorecards, rankings and underlying benchmark data.
sources.dq_note: Self-reported and assessed by WBA. Never merged into a mandatory column.

sources.name: Net Zero Tracker
sources.gives: Interim and net-zero pledges where SBTi has none
sources.licence_full: No explicit open licence. The API is published free and without a key and the methodology page asks to be cited as: Net Zero Tracker.
sources.dq_note: Pledge text, so the implied annual rate is inferred from the target year.

sources.name: Corporate emission reports
sources.gives: Scope 1 and 2 parsed out of published report PDFs
sources.licence_full: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL), declared on both dataset cards.
sources.dq_note: Machine-read from the company's own PDF. 17 rows flagged as suspect.

sources.name: NGFS Phase 5
sources.gives: The 2030 carbon price the damage model runs on
sources.licence_full: IIASA NGFS Phase 5 Scenario Explorer terms of use: free to use with citation, liability disclaimed by IIASA and the scenario modelling teams.
sources.dq_note: GCAM says 99 US$2010 and REMIND 284 for the same scenario. We show GCAM.

sources.name: WRI Aqueduct 4.0
sources.gives: Basin water stress joined to GHGRP facility coordinates
sources.licence_full: World Resources Institute, Aqueduct 4.0 (2023), CC BY 4.0
sources.dq_note: WRI models the basin. The coordinates come from GHGRP filings.

sources.name: Climate TRACE
sources.gives: Equity-share emissions inferred from satellites and activity
sources.licence_full: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), per climatetrace.org/data
sources.dq_note: A cross-check on the EPA spine. 2026 carries six months only.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.gives: Prices, beta and the EV/EBITDA multiple
sources.licence_full: Yahoo Finance terms of service, no redistribution grant
sources.dq_note: Market data only. 34 multiples fall back to the sector median.

sources.name: ESG vendor scores
sources.gives: A consensus percentile used to benchmark our rank
sources.licence_full: CC0 asserted by the uploader. Licence as asserted by the Kaggle uploader, which is not the uploader's to assert: these files are third-party re-uploads of commercial ESG rating products.
sources.dq_note: Third-party re-uploads of commercial ratings. Input to no score.

sources.name: CDP scores
sources.gives: Nothing. The published embeds carry no tonnage
sources.licence_full: CDP Terms of Website Use: scores must not be used for anything other than internal, non-commercial use without prior written consent from CDP.
sources.dq_note: 268 of the 500 are graded. Zero numeric emissions cells, so zero columns.
